title: This is what i built, with the help of GPT ASTRA and Opus 5.5
author: Ok_Zookeepergame5024
selftext:
Hello Everyone,   
I am a software engineer, built my first game in 2017, after that , i built over a hundred of unfinished games that i never published - was trying to be perfectionnist , but today, i am happy to show what i finally released, still not good tho , but i tried my best to release it first then improve it later.

it's not a AAA game or well polished game, but to me it's something, and i will be more than happy to take critics/ideas on how to improve it.

[(572) Dogfighters: Missiles and Flares - YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/W3nIrXS87bc)
